title: Impact of Statin Therapy on Muscle Mitochondrial Function and Aerobic Capacity

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this study is to test how different doses of a statin, Lipitor, affect muscle health and function, and cardiovascular fitness.

Posted outcomes: Difference in Mitochondrial Respiratory Function. timeframe=value at 12 months minus value at baseline. Placebo=36 (±366); Low Dose Statin=32 (±213); High Dose Statin=-3 (±180). p=0.6051
